objs.name: document
objs.description: Managed artifact created, edited, released, distributed, archived, revised, invalidated, reactivated, translated, and linked in DHC VISION.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Corresponding type selected when a new document is created; document types can be changed or added.

attributes.name: document_level
attributes.description: Level used to differentiate documents for structuring and evaluation options.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: By default includes document type abbreviation, consecutive number, and title.

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Document type abbreviation included in the document name by default.

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Cross-client, consecutive, 4-digit number for each type included in the name by default.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Title component of the document name.

attributes.name: reference
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties to link documents to Master data or other documents.

attributes.name: it_application
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties to link documents to IT applications.

attributes.name: relevant_company
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties.

attributes.name: area_of_validity
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Metadata that can be printed in the document; versions are managed through document versioning.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Metadata that can be printed in the document; documents pass through workflow and lifecycle statuses.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Metadata that can be printed in the document using TAG technology.

attributes.name: reader
attributes.description: Attribute assigning reader authorizations via User Group assignment.

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: Attribute assigning author authorization and identifying the registered author.

attributes.name: co_author
attributes.description: Attribute assigning additional personal change rights.

attributes.name: reviewer
attributes.description: Attribute assigning reviewer participants and authorizations.

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: Attribute assigning releaser participants and authorizations, including translation.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which validity period count starts, based on document release.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period used with Valid From to calculate Valid Until; can be defined for each document type.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date calculated from Valid From and Period Of Extended Validity.

attributes.name: distribution_by_info
attributes.description: Distribution attribute whose changes affect e-mail notification when the next version is released.

attributes.name: distribution_for_acknowledgement
attributes.description: Distribution attribute whose changes affect distribution of the workflow task when the next version is released.

objs.name: document_type
objs.description: Classification selected for a document; examples include policy, guideline, procedural instruction, and work instruction.

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Type abbreviation used in document names and not language-independent.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period for which a validity check is necessary; can be defined for each document type.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Duration documents are archived before physical deletion; can be defined for each document type.

objs.name: policy
objs.description: Document type containing company-wide regulations and processes at a strategic level.

objs.name: guideline
objs.description: Document type describing locally defined regulations or regulations relating to a business process.

objs.name: procedural_instruction
objs.description: Document type describing specific procedures, process sequence, details, and responsible persons.

objs.name: work_instruction
objs.description: Document type documenting detailed work steps relevant for a few departments.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Template defined for a document type and selected when creating new document objects.

objs.name: object_cover
objs.description: Pure object cover to which external files or documents can be uploaded or new documents generated.

objs.name: external_file
objs.description: File or document uploaded to an object cover.

objs.name: office_format
objs.description: Standard MS Office formats used to generate new documents, such as Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.

objs.name: metadata
objs.description: Standardized and customer-specific document information maintained automatically or by users.

objs.name: category
objs.description: Grouping of attributes and metadata according to purpose, such as Master data or Control (release).

objs.name: user
objs.description: Person involved in authoring, reviewing, releasing, translating, reading, receiving notifications, confirming acknowledgement, or processing workflow tasks.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Group used for assigning authorizations, readers, distribution, archive access, and role memberships.

objs.name: authorization
objs.description: Read and change rights assigned to groups of users or persons for each document.

objs.name: role
objs.description: System role available in the document management solution, such as reader, author, checker, approver, and translator.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document added to a main document and automatically released with the main document; subject to versioning and statuses of the main document release process.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Document attachment not subject to the release cycle of the main document and without its own release cycle.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Object created for a document to propose changes without affecting content or version history until scheduled for implementation.

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: Workflow-supported processing for release, validity extension, override, reactivation, translation, and acknowledgement tasks.

objs.name: workflow_task
objs.description: Task assigned to users in workflow processes and completed by participants.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: Signature used by workflow participants to complete tasks and documented for each released version.

objs.name: audit_trail
objs.description: Functionality ensuring complete traceability in approval processes.

objs.name: e_mail_notification
objs.description: Notification informing users about workflow tasks, document status, Change proposals, release, validity extension, override, acknowledgement, and completion.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: System-created request linked to a document 30 days before validity expires and processed with workflow support.

objs.name: request_for_aks
objs.description: Request created to invalidate a selected document and start the override workflow automatically.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: Request created for revalidating invalidated documents and starting the reactivation workflow automatically.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List maintained for each document by assigning User Groups or persons for distribution by e-mail or acknowledgement.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: Confirmation requested from distribution recipients and documented for authors or other key roles.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: Role-specific view listing relevant documents and details for users.

objs.name: report
objs.description: Role-specific evaluation report or search for documents, instructions, statuses, and acknowledgements.

objs.name: process
objs.description: Process with which documents can be automatically linked.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: Organizational unit with which documents can be automatically linked.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: Risk with which documents can be automatically linked.

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: Master data with which documents can be linked, such as IT applications.

objs.name: it_application
objs.description: Example of Master data to which documents can be linked.

objs.name: client
objs.description: Client in a multi-client system where document visibility can be specified.

objs.name: language_version
objs.description: Translated language-dependent version of a released document.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Create a new document in the system by attaching a new information object and selecting the corresponding document type.

evts.name: select_document_type
evts.description: Select the corresponding document type when attaching a new information object.

evts.name: select_document_template
evts.description: Select one of the document templates defined for the document type when creating a new object.

evts.name: create_object_cover
evts.description: Create a pure object cover for external files or document generation.

evts.name: upload_external_file
evts.description: Upload external files or documents to an object cover.

evts.name: generate_document
evts.description: Generate new documents based on standard MS Office formats.

evts.name: edit_document_property
evts.description: Open and maintain the document properties and metadata.

evts.name: maintain_metadata
evts.description: Maintain standardized and customer-specific metadata automatically or by the user.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: Edit content using the editing client and local Office component.

evts.name: save_document
evts.description: Save the document after content editing.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatically and system-supported convert a saved document to PDF.

evts.name: display_document
evts.description: Display the current PDF version on the web.

evts.name: change_document_content
evts.description: Make subsequent changes to document content.

evts.name: change_document_property
evts.description: Make subsequent changes to document properties.

evts.name: create_editing_version
evts.description: Create a new editing version when released documents are changed or revised.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Assign group and person-related authorizations via property editing.

evts.name: assign_workflow_participant
evts.description: Assign participants in the release process via document properties.

evts.name: add_additional_info
evts.description: Add additional information to a document.

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: Add an Attachment to a document.

evts.name: release_additional_info
evts.description: Release and publish additional information directly via switches in the properties.

evts.name: publish_additional_info
evts.description: Publish additional information directly via switches in the properties.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: Delete additional information directly.

evts.name: modify_additional_info
evts.description: Modify additional information.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: Modify an Attachment, which triggers a new version of the associated main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Mark released Attachments for archiving and archive them with the release of the next main document version.

evts.name: start_release_process
evts.description: Initiate the 3-step approval process after document creation, maintenance, and control definition.

evts.name: sign_creator_step
evts.description: Registered author signs in the Creator workflow step.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Reviewers check document content according to technical and formal aspects.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Releaser completes release so the document is finally released.

evts.name: reject_document
evts.description: Reject during review or release, canceling workflow for subsequent participants.

evts.name: send_e_mail_notification
evts.description: System informs involved users of workflow status, tasks, Change proposals, release, validity extension, override, and acknowledgement.

evts.name: complete_workflow_task
evts.description: Workflow participants complete tasks with an electronic signature or acknowledgement task without signature.

evts.name: document_signature
evts.description: Document signatures of individual participants in the system for each released version.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Automatically publish the document after release so it is visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: revise_document
evts.description: Revise a valid and released document, automatically creating a new editing version.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Create a Change proposal for a document without affecting content or version history.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: Schedule a Change proposal for implementation, creating a new document version.

evts.name: edit_change_proposal
evts.description: Author documents editing of assigned Change proposals directly in the Change proposal.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: Complete Change proposals so they are no longer displayed in the document.

evts.name: create_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: System creates a request for validity extension 30 days before validity expires.

evts.name: process_validity_extension
evts.description: Process the request for validity extension with workflow support.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Declare additional validity, delete request for validity extension, and update Valid Until.

evts.name: terminate_validity_extension_process
evts.description: Automatically terminate validity extension process when a revised version is released or suspension is declared.

evts.name: create_request_for_aks
evts.description: Create a request for AKS for a selected document.

evts.name: start_aks_workflow
evts.description: Start workflow for processing the request for AKS automatically after attachment.

evts.name: override_document
evts.description: Declare document out of force, invalidate and archive documents and attachments.

evts.name: archive_document
evts.description: Archive invalidated documents by revoking authorizations except archive group.

evts.name: physically_delete_document
evts.description: Physically delete documents after the archive period expires.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: Create a request for reactivation in the provided folder and select the corresponding document.

evts.name: start_reactivation_workflow
evts.description: Start the reactivation workflow automatically.

evts.name: confirm_reactivation
evts.description: Confirm reactivation, creating a new version of the document.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Re-validate invalidated documents and restore original status except version number and status.

evts.name: reactivate_attachment
evts.description: Reactivate Attachments archived with the document.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: Maintain distribution lists by assigning User Groups or persons for each document.

evts.name: distribute_by_e_mail
evts.description: Inform directly assigned users and users of assigned User Groups by e-mail when a new document version is released.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Automatically request distribution recipients by e-mail to confirm acknowledgement upon release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Recipient actively confirms acknowledgement of a released document version.

evts.name: notify_acknowledgement_completion
evts.description: Notify the author team as soon as all persons in Distribution have confirmed acknowledgement.

evts.name: fill_dashboard
evts.description: Fill user and role-specific dashboards using distribution groups in the document distribution list.

evts.name: evaluate_document
evts.description: Evaluate documents, instructions, statuses, workflow statuses, or acknowledgements using reports.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translate released content and documents into another language.

evts.name: check_translation
evts.description: Check translated version with workflow support.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Release translated version with workflow support.

evts.name: specify_client_visibility
evts.description: Specify in which clients a document is visible or not.

evts.name: create_local_document
evts.description: Create a new document in a client to make a local addition to a document.

evts.name: create_reference
evts.description: Create a reference to the original document from a local document.

evts.name: link_document
evts.description: Link documents with processes, organizational units, risks, other documents, and Master data.

Translated language versions provide language-dependent display of released documents.
Documents can be linked with other documents and local documents can reference original documents.
Attachments are automatically released with the release of the main document and archived or reactivated with it.
